stories.title: Brees, Fitzgerald, Kuechly enter Hall of Fame
stories.summary: Drew Brees, Larry Fitzgerald and Luke Kuechly were among those inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame on Saturday.

stories.title: Carrington tossed after foul to Cunningham's head
stories.summary: The Sky's DiJonai Carrington was assessed a flagrant 2 and ejected Saturday after a hard foul across the face and neck area of Fever guard Sophie Cunningham.

stories.title: Clark faces ban after 8th tech; Fever file appeal
stories.summary: Fever star Caitlin Clark's eighth technical foul, which she received after bumping an official during Saturday's win over the Sky, has been rescinded by the WNBA, meaning she will not be suspended.

stories.title: Messi misses Miami game following father's death
stories.summary: Lionel Messi will miss Inter Miami's Leagues Cup match against Monterrey on Saturday following the death of his father, Jorge Messi.

stories.title: Improving Shanahan plans to coach preseason
stories.summary: Kyle Shanahan intends to coach the 49ers' preseason opener against the Titans as he closes in on full recovery from last month's car crash.
